body:
Hi @Iuriy-Budnikov thanks for participating in this repository!

We knew we messed up the BEM notation when we first released InstantSearch.js but thought "Well it's just a notation, people will not really bother".

Since you opened this PR, it must be bothering to you, could you give us more context on how our current BEM notation is affecting your work?

Ultimately this change is a breaking change because most websites would then fail with their current CSS so we cannot change it just like that.

Let me know what you think.
